unchanged: Readiness vocabulary, dimension gates and thresholds from 0.2.0 remain in force; frozen campaigns retain their recorded contracts and verdicts.
profile_identity: Every dimension used in a prospective readiness verdict must carry the same exact selected deployment profile ID (artifact, quantization, runtime/build, hardware, context, template, prompt lane, sampler, effective reasoning control and budget lane). No cross-profile dimension substitution or implicit best-of-lanes aggregation.
blocked_execution: FAILED_EXECUTION issues no verdict. BLOCKED issues no verdict unless INTEGRATION_QUALITY=BLOCKED is independently demonstrated for the selected profile; a fixture, placement, harness, methodology, prerequisite or human-decision block alone never implies INTEGRATION_BLOCKED model readiness.
